messages:
Ruth: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — eviction cascade during the midnight deploy. Need owners, Jiras, and a short RACI for 3 action items: immediate mitigation, monitoring/dashboarding, and CI gating. Please ack and add ETAs by EOD.

Diego: I can own immediate mitigation (auto-throttle + temp threshold bump). R=Diego, A=Ruth, C=Maya. ETA: 3 business days.

Maya: I'll take CI gating and regression harness. R=Maya, A=Ruth, C=Diego. ETA: PR with tests by next Wed.

Diego: I'll also draft a small canary plan for the throttle change and include rollback steps.

Ruth: Created PM-2630 and linked issues: OPS-4201 (mitigation), OPS-4202 (monitoring/dashboards), OPS-4203 (regression gate).

Ops Bot: Created Jira issues OPS-4201, OPS-4202, OPS-4203 and linked to PM-2630.

Maya: OPS-4203 assigned to Maya. I'll add deterministic repros and a 24h staging pass requirement.

Diego: OPS-4201 assigned to Diego. Will attach canary config and current eviction metrics.

Ruth: Proposal for a short ticket-aging automation to keep items from going stale:

```
Jira automation:
when: issue created or updated
if: status not in (Done, Cancelled) and days since created >= 4
then: comment "Owner review required — update ETA or escalate"; add label "needs-review"; notify #postmortems
```

Maya: +1 on automation. Also suggest adding label "recurring-pattern" to PM-2630 since similar spikes happened twice this quarter.

Ruth: Hand-off plan for next 2 weeks: week1 primary = Diego (mitigations), week2 primary = Maya (tests & validation), Ruth will rotate as backup. Please update your Jira tickets with owner, ETA, and concise acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow. If blocked, mark ticket blocker and ping me. :white_check_mark:
